name: RaceDay Part 2 CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Get repository files
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: 10.0.x

      - name: Restore packages
        run: dotnet restore Part2/RaceDayAPI/RaceDayAPI.Tests/RaceDayAPI.Tests.csproj

      - name: Build API and tests
        run: dotnet build Part2/RaceDayAPI/RaceDayAPI.Tests/RaceDayAPI.Tests.csproj --no-restore --configuration Release

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: dotnet test Part2/RaceDayAPI/RaceDayAPI.Tests/RaceDayAPI.Tests.csproj --no-build --configuration Release --verbosity normal
